name: Whole Spices & Seeds
shortDesc: Unprocessed, sun-cured, Sortex-cleaned whole spices directly from India's traditional growing belts.
description: India produces some of the world's finest whole spices, revered for their rich volatile essential oils, robust pungency, and natural shelf-life. Wonderxasia sources harvest-fresh whole seeds, pods, berries, and rhizomes directly from certified farmers and mandis across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu. Machine-cleaned or Sortex-cleaned to European and US FDA standards.

name: Ground & Powdered Spices
shortDesc: Cryo-ground and fine-milled pure spices with preserved volatile oil content and vibrant natural hues.
description: Our ground spice range undergoes precision milling at controlled temperatures to prevent heat degradation of natural flavour compounds. 100% pure, unadulterated powders with zero artificial colouring, fillers, or starch additions. Rigorously tested for moisture, ash levels, aflatoxins, and microbial safety.

name: Blended Masalas & Seasonings
shortDesc: Authentic regional Indian culinary spice formulations tailored to international palate and packaging standards.
description: Masterfully formulated blends capturing authentic Indian culinary profiles: from royal Hyderabadi biryani masala to aromatic north Indian garam masala and zesty chaat masala. Formulations can be adjusted for salt content, heat scale (SHU), and customized recipe briefs for foodservice chains or retail private labeling.

name: Basmati Rice
shortDesc: Aged traditional long-grain Indian Basmati rice with exquisite aroma and exceptional elongation.
description: Cultivated in the mineral-rich foothills of the Himalayas, our Basmati rice represents pinnacle culinary luxury. Naturally aged for minimum 1 to 2 years to achieve maximum grain elongation, non-sticky fluffiness, and distinctive floral aroma upon cooking. Full Sortex cleaned with silky finish.

name: Grains
shortDesc: Premium Indian grains including wheat, maize, millet, and sorghum sourced directly from India's grain belts.
description: India is one of the world's largest grain producers. Our grain range covers wheat varieties, maize, millets (bajra, ragi, jowar), and sorghum — all cleaned, graded, and packed to international food safety standards. Ideal for flour mills, feed manufacturers, and food processors worldwide.

name: Pulses, Lentils & Beans (Dals)
shortDesc: Cleaned, polished, shelf-stable protein staples including Masoor, Chana, Rajma, Moong, and Urad.
description: High-protein Indian legumes and pulses, laser-sorted to ensure uniform grain size, high germination purity, and absence of foreign matter or broken seeds. Sourced directly from major pulse-growing states including Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Karnataka.

name: Nuts & Dried Fruits
shortDesc: Export-grade crunchy Cashews, sweet Golden Raisins, and rich Californian-style Almonds.
description: Sun-ripened dry fruits and premium processed nuts hand-graded by count and colour. Indian cashew kernels (W180, W240, W320) processed in state-of-the-art hygienic facilities in Mangalore and Goa. Golden Malayar and Green Indian raisins carefully dried to retain natural sweetness and soft chew.

name: Edible Oils
shortDesc: Cold-pressed pure Sesame & Mustard oils retaining maximum pungency and natural antioxidants.
description: Shelf-stable traditional pantry essentials crafted using time-honoured techniques. Kachi Ghani (cold pressed) mustard and sesame oils retaining maximum pungency and natural antioxidants. Sourced from premium oilseed growing regions of Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu.

name: Natural Sweeteners
shortDesc: Chemical-free traditional cane Jaggery and natural sweetener alternatives from India's sugarcane heartlands.
description: Unrefined natural sweeteners crafted using traditional methods. Our jaggery range includes solid blocks, cubes, and free-flowing powder — all processed without chemical treatment or artificial coloring. Rich in minerals and natural caramel sweetness, these products serve as healthy alternatives to refined sugar.

name: Cattle Feed
shortDesc: High-protein animal feed ingredients including Mustard Oil Cake, Soybean Meal, Maize DDGS, and Cottonseed Meal.
description: Premium quality cattle feed ingredients sourced from India's agricultural heartlands. Our range includes protein-rich oilseed meals, grain by-products, and compound feed formulations suitable for dairy farms, poultry operations, and livestock nutrition programs. All products are tested for protein content, moisture, aflatoxin levels, and mycotoxin safety.

name: Auto Parts — 2 Wheeler & 3 Wheeler
shortDesc: OEM & aftermarket spare parts for motorcycles, scooters, and three-wheelers including engine components, brakes, and fasteners.
description: Comprehensive range of 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler spare parts manufactured in India's automotive hubs of Ludhiana, Rajkot, and Chennai. From precision-engineered engine internals like piston kits and valve sets to braking systems, electrical components, and industrial-grade fasteners — all produced under ISO 9001 certified facilities with strict quality control.
